title: The Village That Sold Tomorrow
look: 2D bean-head stick-limb characters inside true Three.js 3D worlds; warm cinematic storybook lighting; sentence-case word-pop captions

sets.description: Prosperous village square, timber market stalls, stone well, colorful awnings, wheat baskets, layered rooftops and distant hills
Ornate town hall interior, timber beams, tall windows, brass chandelier, carved desk, ledgers and wall clock
Rolling golden fields, windmill, barns, irrigation channel, wheat bundles and distant mountains
Deserted village square at cold dawn, closed stalls, scattered ledgers, dust and abandoned carts
Giant enclosed archive chamber, towering shelves, floating paper contracts, brass gears and illuminated ledger

shots.action: Villager sells glowing calendar page marked TOMORROW; buyers reach eagerly.
Coins land in seller's hand as calendar page changes hands.
Queue trades salary envelopes and harvest tokens.
Farmer hands over miniature wheat sheaf for next year's harvest.
Mayor stamps contract with delighted grin.
Shops rise, awnings spread, square fills with celebration.
Party lights glow; villagers dance as coins cascade into fountain.
Mayor laughs; dark shadow crosses his smile.
Villager reaches for sold contract; brass lock snaps shut.
Farmers hand over last sheaves; empty fields behind.
Workers slide salary envelopes across desk, pockets empty.
Mayor signs ten years of taxes; calendar pages unroll.
At dawn, market stalls stand bare and silent.
Loose cart wheel rolls past abandoned fields and broken scarecrow.
Empty square; one paper receipt tumbles across cobbles.
Mayor enters silent town hall; old contract drawer ajar.
Drawer opens into vast chamber of contracts and ledgers.
Brittle parchment unfolds; wax seals catch the light.
Gold threads connect future payments to buyers' names.
Salary envelopes and harvest tokens flow along brass channels.
Mayor's own salary envelope pulled from desk.
Mayor's grin vanishes; hands empty.
Once-rich village looks hollow and still from above.
Wind moves through abandoned fields; no harvesters remain.
Final page reveals every future payment already assigned.
Village colors drain into muted dawn tones.
Mayor stands alone beneath huge wall clock.
Empty square waits as sun rises beyond rooftops.
Clock strikes; last calendar page flips forward.
Camera rises above silent village as final empty calendar page drifts skyward.
